test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Bill, 2022, was passed in December 2022 and is related to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Uttar Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Bill, 2022** was passed in December 2022.
 
• **The Bill aims to modify the list of Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs)** in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This amendment was necessary to accommodate **various communities' demands** for inclusion or exclusion in the SC/ST list.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has a significant population of SCs and STs, making such amendments crucial for social justice and representation.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Bihar
 Bihar has its own distinct set of SCs and STs, but this particular amendment does not pertain to Bihar.
 
 

 Uttarakhand
 Uttarakhand also has SCs and STs, but this amendment is not related to this state.
 
 

 Uttar Pradesh
 This state is the focus of The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Bill, 2022.
 
 

 Karnataka
 Karnataka has a different set of issues and amendments related to SCs and STs, not connected to this bill.
